statement: Phase 2 baseline gap is real at every declared coordinate: no sbt-assembly plugin, no mainClass or assemblyJarName, no ledger-path override in Main, no jar ignore rule, and no assembly/release workflow — so the engine is source-distributed and CWD-fragile, not a downloadable self-contained jar.
justification: Advisor-authored: confirms each fat-jar acceptance criterion (13-16) is net-new work in the current baseline before any packaging CU is drafted.
